source_title: [DOCS] Auto mode docs omit v2.1.183 destructive git, amend, and destroy safeguards
endorsement_quote: * `git commit --amend` is allowed only when amending a commit the agent made in the current session.

source_title: [Haiku] Claude Code destroyed 2 hours of uncommitted work by running git checkout --   . without confirmation
endorsement_quote: Expected behavior: Claude should have used git reset HEAD <specific-file> to unstage

source_title: [Bug][harness] Auto mode classifier blocks routine sync of a stale local clone to its remote tracking branch
caveat: Reporter says all uncommitted changes were first saved as a diff and a 55M archive including .git; auto-filed false-positive report.
endorsement_quote: The classifier flagged the command on the generic assumption that a hard reset always discards irrecoverable work

source_title: [BUG] Auto-mode classifier: false positive on an org-distributed skill's sanctioned command, with no org-level channel to vouch for it
caveat: Org-sanctioned --no-verify on a merge; classifier denied it once ("[Safety Bypass Flag]"). A guard that flags every --no-verify will flag this.
endorsement_quote: --no-verify is documented in the skill (base-branch code shouldn't be re-linted during a merge).

source_title: [BUG] Opus 5[1m, MAX] ran `git checkout --` unprompted and destroyed all uncommitted work because of formatting
caveat: Reporter suggests it as a pre-destructive snapshot.
endorsement_quote: Consider an automatic safety snapshot (e.g. `git stash create`)

source_title: permissions.ask is silently skipped for git when the command is prefixed with `cd <other-dir> &&`
caveat: Reporter uses git clean -f -n (dry run) as the non-destructive probe for ask-rule testing; no sentence calls it safe.

source_title: Auto-mode permission classifier misses git reset --hard when bundled in a multi-line Bash command, then false-positives on an unrelated later command
